g = ts_mean((close - vwap_last_hour)/vwap_last_hour, 5)
hot = cs_rank(volume/ts_mean(volume, 20)) > 1.3
r = cs_zscore(at_zero2nan(-cs_rank(g) * hot))
k_fcf = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(free_cash_flow)/mktcap))
k_iss = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 252) - 1))
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + 2*at_nan2zero(k_fcf) + 2*at_nan2zero(k_iss))

o = ts_mean(open/ts_delay(close, 1) - 1, 5)
r = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(o))
k_fcf = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(free_cash_flow)/mktcap))
k_iss = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 252) - 1))
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + 2*at_nan2zero(k_fcf) + 2*at_nan2zero(k_iss))

# Thesis: momentum built from many small steady moves ("frog in the pan") is under-noticed and persists; momentum from a few big jumps gets priced fast.
# Source: Da, Gurun & Warachka, "Frog in the Pan: Continuous Information and Momentum" (Review of Financial Studies 2014).
pret = close/ts_delay(close, 250) - 1  # past 12-month return
sgn = (pret > 0)*2 - 1  # +1 winners, -1 losers
idisc = sgn*(ts_mean(ret1 < 0, 250) - ts_mean(ret1 > 0, 250))  # information discreteness: low = continuous (many small same-sign days)
alpha = cs_rank(pret) * (2 - cs_rank(idisc))  # momentum, amplified where information arrived continuously (nonlinear interaction)

# Thesis: improving fundamentals (rising profitability and cash flow, falling leverage, better asset turnover and margins) are under-reacted to, so the CHANGE in a firm's financial health predicts returns even when its level does not.
# Source: Piotroski, "Value Investing: The Use of Historical Financial Statement Information to Separate Winners from Losers" (Journal of Accounting Research 2000); Soliman, "The Use of DuPont Analysis by Market Participants" (The Accounting Review 2008).
ta = ts_fill(total_assets)  # total assets, filled between reports
roa = ts_fill(return_on_assets)  # return on assets
d1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(roa - ts_delay(roa, 250)))  # one-year change in ROA
cf = ts_fill(cash_from_operations)/ta  # operating cash flow per dollar of assets
d2 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(cf - ts_delay(cf, 250)))  # one-year change in cash-flow profitability
lev = ts_fill(total_debt)/ta  # leverage
d3 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(lev - ts_delay(lev, 250)))  # falling leverage is good
tu = ts_fill(sales_to_total_assets_ratio)  # asset turnover
d4 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(tu - ts_delay(tu, 250)))  # rising asset turnover
gm = ts_fill(gross_profit)/ts_fill(net_sales)  # gross margin
d5 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(gm - ts_delay(gm, 250)))  # rising gross margin
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(d1) + at_nan2zero(d2) + at_nan2zero(d3) + at_nan2zero(d4) + at_nan2zero(d5))  # equal-weight fundamental-momentum score

ta = ts_fill(total_assets)
roa = ts_fill(return_on_assets)
d1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(roa - ts_delay(roa, 250)))
cf = ts_fill(cash_from_operations)/ta
d2 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(cf - ts_delay(cf, 250)))
lev = ts_fill(total_debt)/ta
d3 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(lev - ts_delay(lev, 250)))
tu = ts_fill(sales_to_total_assets_ratio)
d4 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(tu - ts_delay(tu, 250)))
gm = ts_fill(gross_profit)/ts_fill(net_sales)
d5 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(gm - ts_delay(gm, 250)))
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(d1) + at_nan2zero(d2) + at_nan2zero(d3) + at_nan2zero(d4) + at_nan2zero(d5))

g = ts_mean((close - vwap_last_hour)/vwap_last_hour, 5)
busy = cs_rank(number_of_trades_last_hour/ts_mean(number_of_trades_last_hour, 20)) > 1.3
p1 = cs_zscore(at_zero2nan(-cs_rank(g) * busy))
a = cs_rank(ts_mean(return_last_hour, 5))
b = cs_rank(ts_mean((close_price_last_hour - low_price_last_hour)/(high_price_last_hour - low_price_last_hour + 0.0001*close), 5))
hot = cs_rank(volume/ts_mean(volume, 20)) > 1.3
p2 = cs_zscore(at_zero2nan(-(a + b + cs_rank(g)) * hot))
sz = cs_rank(at_signlog(mktcap))
vo = cs_rank(ts_std(ret1, 20))
s = cs_factorneut(at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(p1) + at_nan2zero(p2)), [sz, vo])
q = cs_rank(s)
hl = (ts_max(q, 5) > 1.8) * (q > 1.6)
hs = (ts_min(q, 5) < 1.2) * (q < 1.4)
alpha = at_zero2nan(hl - hs)

g = ts_mean((close - vwap_last_hour)/vwap_last_hour, 5)
busy = cs_rank(number_of_trades_last_hour/ts_mean(number_of_trades_last_hour, 20)) > 1.3
r = cs_zscore(at_zero2nan(-cs_rank(g) * busy))
k1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(research_and_development_expense)/mktcap))
k2 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 250) - 1))
k3 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(gross_profit)/ts_fill(total_assets)))
sz = cs_rank(at_signlog(mktcap))
vo = cs_rank(ts_std(ret1, 20))
s = at_nan2zero(cs_factorneut(at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3)), [sz, vo]))
f0 = day_of_the_week < ts_delay(day_of_the_week, 1)
f1 = ts_delay(f0, 1)
f2 = ts_delay(f0, 2)
f3 = ts_delay(f0, 3)
alpha = at_zero2nan(f0*s + (1-f0)*(f1*ts_delay(s, 1) + (1-f1)*(f2*ts_delay(s, 2) + (1-f2)*(f3*ts_delay(s, 3) + (1-f3)*ts_delay(s, 4)))))

s = at_zero2nan(-cs_rank(g) * busy)
z = at_nan2zero(cs_zscore(s))
one = close/close
x = at_nan2zero(ts_delay(z, 1)*ret1)
p = x - cs_indneut(x, one)
